{{Quote|What'd I tell you? Inspiration's my specialty!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="HSaSE" />}}
The '''Mission to Duroon''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] run made by the crew of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to the planet [[Duroon]] for [[loan shark]] [[Ploovo Two-For-One/Legends|Ploovo Two-For-One]].

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] accepted a contract to deliver 1000 carbine energy rifles deep into a steer-clear zone in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. As the pair entered the orbit of [[Duroon]], their [[Starship sensor array|sensors]] picked up a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[lighter]], which had just taken off from an Authority installation on the far side of the planet. In an effort to evade the lighter, Solo attempted a risky dive, deep into the atmosphere of Duroon. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] leveled off low to the ground, above a magma fissure, which would hide them from the lighter's sensors. Flying low and hoping to avoid detection, they flew towards the mountains. Surprised by a narrow cleft, the pilot had to use some expert flying to save the ship. In the process, the ''Millennium Falcon'' lost her long-range sensor dish on the canyon wall.

After setting down, Han Solo and Chewbacca were met by the contract-slaves-turned-insurgents, who were to receive the weapons. These [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] were known as the [[Duroon Rebels]]. The crew unloaded the hold and then tried to repair the sensor dish, to no avail. As they attempted a "blind" lift-off, they were hit by a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] from the waiting lighter. Turning the ship around, Solo went head-to-head with the Authority ship trying to break the tractor beam. The lighter made a last minute evasive maneuver to avoid the ''Millennium Falcon'', which enabled Han Solo and Chewbacca to escape into [[Realspace/Legends|deep space]].
